title: BEA / Annex 13 no-blame investigation rail as prevention-oriented safety-memory infrastructure
summary: BEA and the Annex 13 framework are encoded as a safety-investigation rail: the institutional object is prevention-oriented investigation whose objective is not blame or liability, even when parallel judicial processes exist.

status_history.note: Added as rev0027 aviation human-factors/correction rail.

place.scope: aviation safety correction and human-factors infrastructure

claims.claim: BEA’s legal-context page summarizes ICAO Article 26 and Annex 13 as the accident/incident investigation framework for State responsibilities, notifications, and results.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The same BEA page states that the sole objective of safety investigations is prevention and not apportioning blame or liability, and that protected personal data is not used for other purposes than safety.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The BEA page also summarizes EU Regulation and a BEA-Justice Agreement as coordination surfaces between safety investigation and judicial authority, making legal/safety-status separation a first-class cube distinction.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: independent/no-blame safety investigation surface with formal legal context and coordination with judicial processes
outputs: coordination with judicial authority where applicable
limitations: no-blame safety investigations do not eliminate legal proceedings
public pages do not replace full reports
